content:
Logan Cooley scored with one second remaining in regulation to complete his fourth career hat trick, then Mikhail Sergachev scored 3:27 into overtime to lift the visiting Utah Mammoth to a 4-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Penguins on Thursday night. Pittsburgh's Ben Kindel had nearly won it with a go-ahead goal with 23 seconds left in regulation, and Sebastian Cossa made 31 saves for Utah.

In Dallas, Cole Caufield and Alex Newhook each scored twice as the Montreal Canadiens capped a perfect four-game road trip with a 5-2 win over the Stars. Phillip Danault added a goal and an assist for Montreal, which has earned points in six straight games. Wyatt Johnston had a goal and an assist for Dallas, which lost its second straight game.

Elsewhere, Tage Thompson scored a natural hat trick and added two assists as the visiting Buffalo Sabres rallied for a wild 7-6 win over the Anaheim Ducks, and Quinton Byfield scored 3:37 into overtime as the Los Angeles Kings edged the visiting Ottawa Senators 6-5 after blowing a four-goal lead in the third period.

Carolina stayed perfect behind goaltender Pyotr Kochetkov, who made 24 saves and improved to 9-0-0 on the season in a 3-2 win over the Columbus Blue Jackets. Tampa Bay beat Winnipeg 6-4 behind a goal and three assists from Pontus Holmberg, and Washington earned its third straight win, 4-3 in Nashville, on Alex Tuch's go-ahead goal at 10:09 of the third period.

Matthew Schaefer scored 33 seconds into overtime to lift the New York Islanders to a 4-3 win at Minnesota, Viktor Arvidsson recorded a hat trick in Detroit's 4-1 win over Chicago, St. Louis beat Boston 4-1, and Will Smith scored twice in San Jose's third-period comeback in a 3-2 win over Vancouver.

Sources: Reuters / Field Level Media; NHL.com.

title: NHL October 29 Roundup: Mammoth Stun Penguins in OT, Canadiens Cap Perfect Road Trip in Dallas
